goal: Prevent analyzepsbt from reporting negative fees and advising next roles for impossible transactions
Return an error and set next role to creator when outputs exceed inputs once all inputs are known
agreement: Suggests adding a unit test in psbt_tests (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes misleading analyzepsbt output when transaction outputs exceed known inputs
The fix targets an edge case in analysis diagnostics without altering core transaction handling
